sources: North Carolina Wildlife Resources Commission, Virginia Opossum species profile: when cornered they hiss and drool as a threat display; will feign death while defecating and emitting a foul-smelling greenish substance from its anal glands; 50 teeth, more than any other North American mammal; young weigh 0.13 grams at birth; highly resistant to rabies; resistant to the venom of common venomous snakes; prehensile, nearly hairless tail; https://www.ncwildlife.gov/species/virginia-opossum

National Park Service, Virginia Opossum: may fall into a catatonic state when too stressed, 'playing possum' is an involuntary reaction; 50 teeth, more than any North American land mammal; https://www.nps.gov/cwdw/learn/nature/virginia-opossum.htm

The Nature Conservancy, Cool Green Science, 'Strange and Surprising Facts about Opossums' (2021): remains in the death-feigning state for minutes to hours; emits a foul substance from its anus with a corpse-like smell; teeth visible as in a death grimace; newborns about the size of a honeybee; a litter may be 25 young but females have only 13 nipples, a baby that doesn't fasten to a nipple dies; resistant to most snake venom including rattlesnake and copperhead; rarely contracts rabies; https://blog.nature.org/2021/05/11/strange-and-surprising-facts-about-opossums

Maryland Department of Natural Resources, Opossum: the only marsupial (pouched mammal) native to North America; fakes illness by drooling, which can deter predators since many avoid sick prey; cannot hang upside down by its tail but uses it to climb; exactly 50 teeth; babies the size of a honeybee at birth, nurse in the pouch for two months; mother often carries young on her back; https://dnr.maryland.gov/wildlife/Pages/plants_wildlife/opossum.aspx

beats.say: When it's scared, this animal fakes its own death. And makes itself smell like a corpse.
The Virginia opossum. North America's only pouched mammal.
Corner one at night, and first, it hisses and drools.
Then it drops. Mouth open. Teeth showing, like a death grin.
And it leaks a green goo from its rear end that smells like a rotting body.
It can lie there for minutes. Or for hours.
